question: 2025年各季度、各订单状态的实付销售额分别是多少？（不含取消订单；请按季度与状态列出）
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, status, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY quarter, status ORDER BY quarter, status
pred_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-Q%Q', order_date) AS quarter, status, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY quarter, status ORDER BY quarter, status
